messages:
becky: quick check-in on postmortem actions for token validation/audit/rotation. need owners + short ETAs so this closes this sprint.
omar: i'll take validation tests + CI gate. plan: small e2e that rotates a key and hits five endpoints, assert zero 401s for 5m. ETA: 3d.
jing: i'll own audit enrichment  add `auth.rotation` events with `old_kid`, `new_kid`, `initiator`, `service`. retention 90d hot. will post mapping. ETA: 4d.
corey: infra will add graceful reload (SIGHUP) + phased rollout for critical services. i'll prototype a reload handler. ETA: 1w.
inc-bot: created task PM-4022: "token-rotation-postmortem-actions" (https://issues.redwood/PM-4022)
becky: proposed split: omar -> tests, jing -> audit, corey -> reload/playbook, becky -> customer comms + runbook. owners add triage + blockers to PM-4022 by EOD.
omar: example test i'll add: `./ci/rotate-and-validate.sh --svc api --duration 300`  will run nightly and on PRs that touch auth.
jing: i'll include a saved view and a sample detection query for `auth.rotation`.
corey: will add staggered restart windows and a force-reload CLI for emergencies.
becky: alert suggestion: `token_validation_error_rate > 0.4% over 10m` -> page oncall + create follow-up. also daily digest to #incidents for 7 days after rollout.
omar: ack  i'll wire the smoke test and alert integration.
jing: updating PM-4022 with mapping now.
corey: ping me if you need deploy logs from last Friday.
becky: thanks all ":raised_hands:"  i'll send a short calendar for a 15m sync after owners post triage.
